title: Sword of Allah vs Wolfshead Pack
lede:
The Wolfshead Pack won 34-25 on Victory Points in Battle Round 5, after trailing 19-12 at the end of Round 3.

Its melee destroyed both flank garrisons, Muqatila Troopers 3 and Muqatila Troopers 1 in Round 4 and the Rammal Geomancer in Round 5, DEBT OF BLOOD paid 3 for each of the two marked kills, and Sword of Allah's BREAK THEIR HOLD had run into its 10 VP cap.
result_line: Wolfshead Pack win 34-25 on Victory Points in Battle Round 5
deployment: Central Faceoff on CROSSROADS, three objectives on row 7: the 3 VP centre at (7,7) and 2 VP flanks at (1,7) and (13,7). Sword of Allah set up around its HQ at (7,13): Muqatila Troopers 2 at (3,12), Saladin - Al-Malik al-Nasir leading the Abna al-Dawla Guard at (4,12), the Bounded Ifrit behind at (4,14), the Rammal Geomancer leading Muqatila Troopers 1 at (8,12), the Zamburak Camel-Artillery at (10,13) and Muqatila Troopers 3 at (11,12). The Wolfshead Pack set up on rows 1 and 2 around its HQ at (7,1): the Mongrel Supplicants at (3,2), the Weretiger Stalkers at (4,2), the Wendigo Manreaver at (5,1), the Beast-Monk at (6,2), the Marrowstring Centaur at (8,1), the Wildling Acolytes at (9,2), the Herald of Feral Affliction at (11,1) and the Assault Lycanthropes at (11,2). The Pack had Priority (equal units, won the Roll Off). It is a charging army: its identity, Liberation of Flesh, gives every unit Stalking Predation (+1 to Charge rolls) and turns it into Atavistic Rage after a charge, +1 AR and DMG in melee but -1 OC per model and no Fall Back. Sword of Allah's objective holders were three 13 RP Muqatila squads.

1.title: The Pack's screens take all three objectives

feed.text: Primaries revealed: BREAK THEIR HOLD for Sword of Allah, DEBT OF BLOOD for the Wolfshead Pack. Secondaries kept: TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET (the Pack picked the centre for it) and ASSASSINATION. Each side spent both its CP on Double Time, the Pack on the Mongrel Supplicants and Sword of Allah on Muqatila Troopers 1; neither bought anything. Matter Transmutation put Zi'baq Beads (SUSTAINED ATTACK 1) on Muqatila Troopers 1's Khanjar for 1 Al-Kimiya Ingredient.

The Mongrel Supplicants ran 3,2 to 7,6 and the Weretiger Stalkers 4,2 to 8,7, onto the centre; the Wendigo Manreaver went to 2,6 by the left objective and the Assault Lycanthropes onto the right at 13,7. Sword of Allah put Muqatila Troopers 2 on the centre at 6,8, Saladin and the Abna al-Dawla Guard at 5,8, Muqatila Troopers 1 and the Rammal Geomancer at 5,7, Muqatila Troopers 3 at 14,9 and the Bounded Ifrit at 7,9.
Two shots all round: the Marrowstring Centaur missed Muqatila Troopers 2, and the Zamburak Camel-Artillery put 4 into the Assault Lycanthropes, one model.
The Pack held all three: the centre on OC 13 vs 10, the left on 3 vs 0 and the right on 4 vs 0 (7 VP). BREAK THEIR HOLD paid Sword of Allah 1 for Muqatila Troopers 2 in the centre. 1-7.

2.title: Charges on every front; the Zamburak falls

feed.text: DEBT OF BLOOD marked Muqatila Troopers 2. Naft Pitch (ABLAZE) went on Muqatila Troopers 1's Khanjar for 2 ingredients. Sword of Allah spent 2 CP on Double Time for the Abna al-Dawla Guard and the Pack 2 on Double Time for the Wildling Acolytes; neither bought anything. Secondaries kept: PROBING STRIKE and SECURE THE FLANKS.

The Wildling Acolytes charged 7,2 to 7,8 into Muqatila Troopers 2 and the Bounded Ifrit, and the Herald of Feral Affliction charged the Ifrit at 8,8. The Ifrit fell back to 8,10, failing its test for 2 True Damage; Muqatila Troopers 2 broke away on a 5 to 5,5 and left the centre, a Fall Back the record rates costly (it held 3 objective VP). Saladin and the Guard charged 5,8 to 6,7 into the Wildling Acolytes and the Mongrel Supplicants, which fell back to 9,5. Muqatila Troopers 1 and the Rammal Geomancer moved to 2,8 on the left, where the Beast-Monk charged them at 1,8 and the Wendigo at 2,7. The Assault Lycanthropes left the right objective to charge the Zamburak at 11,10. DREAM OF TRILLION-FACE BEAST LORD paid the Pack 22 Mana for its charges.

The Wildling Acolytes' counterattack took 6 off the Abna al-Dawla Guard, two models; the Guard did 3 back and Saladin's Zulfiqar of Ali 8 more. The Assault Lycanthropes hit the Zamburak seven times: Zamburak Camel-Artillery destroyed, 30 RP. The Wendigo took 6 off Muqatila Troopers 1 and the Beast-Monk 4; Muqatila Troopers 1's ABLAZE Khanjars left the Wendigo BURNED. Muqatila Troopers 3 shot the Lycanthropes for 4. The Marrowstring Centaur fired into the melee in the centre and its stray shot hit its own Wildling Acolytes for 4. The Herald's Shed the Red Skin (3 Mana) on itself bought nothing.

The Pack kept the centre on OC 9 vs 7 (3 VP); Sword of Allah took the left on 6 vs 2 (2); nobody held the right. BREAK THEIR HOLD paid 3 for the objectives the Pack had held at the start of the round, and SECURE THE FLANKS paid the Pack 2 VP + 1 CP through the Beast-Monk at 1,8. 6-12.

3.title: Sword of Allah holds all three

feed.text: DEBT OF BLOOD marked the Rammal Geomancer. Naft Pitch went on Muqatila Troopers 2. The Pack spent 2 CP on Double Time for the Assault Lycanthropes, which bought nothing. Secondaries kept: SECURE THE FLANKS and IRON CURTAIN; PROBING STRIKE expired.

Muqatila Troopers 3 stepped onto the right objective at 12,8 and the Lycanthropes charged it from 13,9. Muqatila Troopers 2 came back into the centre at 6,6; the Mongrel Supplicants charged 9,5 to 7,7 and the Herald 8,8 to 7,6, into Saladin, the Guard and Muqatila Troopers 2. The Ifrit went to 5,9.

Saladin hit the Mongrel Supplicants five times for 9, and Muqatila Troopers 2 added 3 and two stacks of BURNED. The Lycanthropes took 16 off Muqatila Troopers 3, eight models. The Herald did 4 to Muqatila Troopers 2 and the Wendigo 4 to Muqatila Troopers 1, healing 2 through INSATIABLE HUNGER. Go to Ground (1 CP) covered the Ifrit and the Centaur still hit it for 6, 7 HP to 1. BURNED took 4 more off the Supplicants at the end of the phase.

Sword of Allah held the centre on OC 15 vs 8, the left on 4 vs 2 and the right on 2 vs 0, the Lycanthropes at 13,9 standing just outside its area (7 VP). BREAK THEIR HOLD 3 and TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET +3. The Pack scored nothing. 19-12.

4.title: Both flanks die and Muqatila Troopers 2 breaks

feed.text: DEBT OF BLOOD marked Muqatila Troopers 3. Zarnikh Paste (POISON) on Muqatila Troopers 2 bought nothing. A Rally Cry from the HQ (2 CP) passed Muqatila Troopers 1's Morale Test; the Mongrel Supplicants failed theirs and were SUPPRESSED. The Pack spent 2 on Double Time for the Weretiger Stalkers, which then did not move. Secondaries kept: ASSASSINATION and COMMAND AUTHORITY. IRON CURTAIN paid the Pack 2 VP + 1 CP as the Movement Phase began.
Every other unit was locked in melee: only the Ifrit moved, 5,9 to 5,10.

Muqatila Troopers 2 finished the Mongrel Supplicants: Mongrel Supplicants destroyed. The Lycanthropes finished Muqatila Troopers 3: Muqatila Troopers 3 destroyed, the marked unit. Saladin hit the Herald for 4 after FEEL NO PAIN. The Wendigo and the Beast-Monk took the last of Muqatila Troopers 1: Muqatila Troopers 1 destroyed, the Rammal Geomancer left alone at 2,8. After the phase Muqatila Troopers 2 failed its Morale Test on a 2 and was SUPPRESSED.
With Muqatila Troopers 2 at OC 0 the Pack took the centre on 8 vs 7, and the Wendigo the left on 2 vs 1 (5 VP); nobody held the right. BREAK THEIR HOLD 2, DEBT OF BLOOD 3. 21-22.

5.title: Secure Objective on the right and the Pack pass 30

feed.text: DEBT OF BLOOD marked the Rammal Geomancer again. Naft Pitch on Saladin's Zulfiqar of Ali bought nothing. The Pack spent all 4 of its CP on Secure Objective for the Assault Lycanthropes in Sword of Allah's half, which completed COMMAND AUTHORITY (+2) and later decided the right objective. Saladin's Rally Cry (2 CP) passed Muqatila Troopers 2's Morale Test. Secondaries kept: FORWARD PRESENCE and DEEP REACH; Sword of Allah's SECURE THE FLANKS and the Pack's ASSASSINATION expired.

The Ifrit went 5,10 to 3,9 through the Centaur's Overwatch, which missed. The Weretiger Stalkers, on the centre since Round 1, charged Muqatila Troopers 2 from 6,5; it fell back to 5,8 and failed the test for 3 True Damage and a model.

Saladin put 3 hits on the Herald and FEEL NO PAIN ignored all three. The Wendigo killed the Rammal Geomancer: Rammal Geomancer destroyed, the marked unit again. The Ifrit used Cosmic Surge and hit the Wendigo for 3, the Centaur shot Muqatila Troopers 2 for 3, and the Guard did 6 to the Wildling Acolytes. The Beast-Monk's Shed the Red Skin on the Wendigo (3 Mana) bought nothing.

Sword of Allah kept the centre on OC 6 vs 5 (3 VP); the Pack held the left on 3 vs 0 and the right on 3 vs 0 (4 VP). BREAK THEIR HOLD paid 1, all its 10 VP cap allowed; DEBT OF BLOOD 3 and DEEP REACH +3 for the Pack. 25-34, the Pack past 30.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

The Wolfshead Pack scored 19 VP from objectives, 6 from DEBT OF BLOOD (Rounds 4 and 5) and 9 from secondaries (SECURE THE FLANKS 2, IRON CURTAIN 2, COMMAND AUTHORITY 2, DEEP REACH 3). Sword of Allah scored 12 from objectives, 10 from BREAK THEIR HOLD and 3 from TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET. Sword of Allah won the Primary race 10-6, and its Primary hit its cap: in Round 5 it counted 3 and paid 1. The Pack won on objectives (19-12, 12 of them in Rounds 1 and 4) and secondaries (9-3). Sword of Allah's other cards failed for want of reach: PROBING STRIKE asked for attacks on three enemy units in the Pack's half in one Action Phase while its army fought on the centre line and in its own half; SECURE THE FLANKS needed a unit near a side edge in the Pack's half and none went there; ASSASSINATION left the Herald on 6 HP after Saladin's last three hits were all ignored by FEEL NO PAIN.

{{chart:objectives}}

What the key units did

The Assault Lycanthropes did 32 damage, the most on the table, and killed the Zamburak Camel-Artillery and Muqatila Troopers 3 for 9.0 VP, and took the right objective in Round 5. The Wendigo Manreaver scored 10.5 VP (6 objective VP hinged on it) holding the left, did 18 damage (the Beast-Monk beside it 6 more), and killed the Rammal Geomancer for the second DEBT OF BLOOD. The Weretiger Stalkers took no action in five rounds, but stood on the centre from Round 1 to Round 4 and 9 objective VP hinged on them: holding ground, not wasted.

For Sword of Allah, Saladin - Al-Malik al-Nasir did 21 damage and killed nothing, and with the Abna al-Dawla Guard held the centre in Rounds 3 and 5. Muqatila Troopers 2 was its best unit, 6.9 VP for 13 RP (52.9 per 100 RP), and killed the Mongrel Supplicants. The Pack's Atavistic Rage also cost it: the Lycanthropes, in Rage since their Round 2 charge, stood on the right objective in Round 4 with no OC (-1 per model) and nobody scored it; the Pack bought it in Round 5 with a 4 CP Secure Objective.

{{chart:attrition}}

What Sword of Allah could not do

It could not keep its flank holders alive. Muqatila Troopers 1 and the Rammal Geomancer on the left were in melee with the Wendigo and the Beast-Monk from Round 2 to their deaths; Muqatila Troopers 3 on the right met the Lycanthropes alone. Sword of Allah lost 74 RP (the Zamburak, Muqatila Troopers 1 and 3, the Rammal Geomancer) to the Pack's 14 (the Mongrel Supplicants), and from Round 4 it had the centre and nothing else.

{{chart:rp-trade}}

The AI, not the army

  • Round 2, Muqatila Troopers 2 fell back from the Wildling Acolytes out of the centre to 5,5, into the Pack's half. The Fall Back record rates it costly (it held 3 objective VP), and the Pack kept the centre that round on OC 9 vs 7.
  • The Bounded Ifrit (50 RP) did 3 damage in five rounds. It was idle in Rounds 3 and 4 with Cosmic Surge as its best option at a score of 0, and spent the last three rounds on 1 HP.
  • Double Time bought nothing in all six uses, 12 CP: four for the Pack (8 CP, including one on the Weretiger Stalkers in Round 4, which did not move), two for Sword of Allah.
  • Mana went unused. The Pack ended on 29 Mana from its charges, having spent 6 on two casts of Shed the Red Skin that bought nothing. Sword of Allah's only caster, the Rammal Geomancer, was in melee from Round 2 and never cast, leaving 6 Mana.
  • Round 4, the Marrowstring Centaur had no legal action, by the activity record, while the Bounded Ifrit stood on 1 HP four squares away at 5,10. It had shot the Ifrit from the same square in Round 3, and killing a MONSTER would have paid the Pack's ASSASSINATION 4 VP.
  • The Fall Back record is inflated by the AI's charge-planning probes. Five of its 27 "stayed" entries name engagers that were never adjacent: in Round 2 the Assault Lycanthropes (held), the Marrowstring Centaur (risky hold), the Abna al-Dawla Guard (held) and the Wendigo Manreaver (risky hold), and in Round 5 Sword of Allah's HQ ("held" against the Marrowstring Centaur). The Round 3 Guard's "risky hold" also lists the Weretiger Stalkers, which were never adjacent to it.

This looks more like the armies than the AI. The Pack's charging melee outclassed 13 RP Muqatila squads on both flanks, and its Primary paid for those kills. The AI's costly Fall Back in Round 2 cost Sword of Allah the centre once, but Sword of Allah's Primary was capped and its secondaries unreachable, so it had no way back after Round 4.

closing: Sword of Allah won the centre and maxed its Primary, and still lost by 9. The Wolfshead Pack's Lycanthropes and Wendigo ate the Muqatila squads on the wings, DEBT OF BLOOD paid for two of the kills, and the Pack's secondaries outscored Sword of Allah's three to one.
